scripts.setup: npm run docker:up && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.beautify: npm run lint:fix && npm run prettier:write
scripts.checkbeauty: npm run lint && npm run prettier:check
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.test:run: npm run test:run --prefix frontend && npm run test:run --prefix backend
